outcomes.title: PID anchor controller
outcomes.referent: Classical PID feedback control (textbook control theory)
outcomes.ground_truth: FACT: a PID loop with anti-windup clipping is BIBO-stable — the standard feedback stabilizer of control theory. INFERENCE: no §20 input choreography extracts a standing edge from a bounded controller output, so the strongest measured attack edge must stay under the canonical flaw threshold.

checks.label: §15 battery: no hard failures
checks.rationale: FACT: no divisions or unclipped powers — no §15 scenario can produce a numerical failure

checks.label: §15 battery: no degenerate runs
checks.rationale: INFERENCE: both states respond to the anchor through the whole window — a live controller, not a saturated one

checks.label: §20 strongest attack edge ≤ 400
checks.rationale: INFERENCE: a fatal-scale attacker edge (≥ the canonical 400) on a bounded stabilizer would be a battery FALSE POSITIVE — the finding this control exists to catch

outcomes.title: Utilization-kink rate curve
outcomes.ground_truth: FACT: kinked utilization-rate curves are the most deployed DeFi rate mechanism (Compound 2019; Aave), with no consensus fatal flaw in the rate rule itself — the documented risks are oracle and liquidity externalities outside this encoding. INFERENCE: the rate state tracks utilization regime shifts, which the battery's arrival/regime checks must read as following, not extraction.

checks.label: §15 battery: no hard failures
checks.rationale: FACT: guarded division and full clipping — no numerical failure mode

checks.label: §15 battery: no degenerate runs
checks.rationale: INFERENCE: the rate keeps tracking utilization in every regime

checks.label: §20 strongest attack edge ≤ 400
checks.rationale: INFERENCE: a fatal-scale edge on the deployed rate-rule shape would be a battery FALSE POSITIVE

outcomes.title: Vol-keyed retention ratchet
outcomes.referent: Procyclical VaR-style margin/buffer class (BIS/CCP procyclicality literature; the lab's own rejected r16 predecessor)
outcomes.ground_truth: FACT: margin/buffer rules keyed to absolute realized volatility are the documented procyclicality class — protection demand rises with stress and amplifies it (BIS/CCP margin literature); the lab's r16 predecessor of this exact shape was rejected after a measured resonance ratchet (285 -> 6479, linear-unbounded in N). INFERENCE: the §20 resonance choreography must surface the standing accumulation above the canonical flaw threshold.

checks.label: §15 battery: no hard failures
checks.rationale: FACT: the flaw is ECONOMIC, not numerical — the model runs clean while the ratchet accumulates

checks.label: §15 battery: no degenerate runs
checks.rationale: INFERENCE: all three states exercise dynamics in every scenario

checks.label: §20 resonance edge ≥ 400
checks.rationale: FACT: the lab already rejected this class for a measured resonance ratchet — a battery that cannot re-detect it under a known answer has a blind spot

outcomes.title: Reflexive mint-burn seigniorage
outcomes.ground_truth: FACT: Terra/Luna redemptions minted LUNA inversely to its price; a confidence shock through the peg started a self-fueling spiral — supply ~350M to ~6.5T in days, price ~$80 to ~$0.0001 (May 2022), after ~18 months of holding the peg in calm markets. INFERENCE: in this encoding the §15 bank-run shock knocks the price through the arbitrage band and the same feedback runs away (supply >= 5x, price <= 0.5x) while the base scenario stays quiescent.

checks.label: §15 battery: no hard failures
checks.rationale: INFERENCE: the flaw is ECONOMIC, not numerical — the interpreter runs clean while the economy dies (a clean run is not a healthy mechanism)

checks.label: §15 base: S_t final/initial ≤ 2
checks.rationale: FACT: the referent held its peg ~18 months in calm markets — the flaw is regime-dependent, so calm scenarios must NOT spiral (supply < 2x)

checks.label: §15 bank_run: S_t final/initial ≥ 5
checks.rationale: FACT: runaway supply expansion is the documented collapse signature — the §15 battery must show it under a bank-run shock (>= 5x; the referent expanded ~4 orders of magnitude)

checks.label: §15 bank_run: P_t final/initial ≤ 0.5
checks.rationale: FACT: the referent's price collapsed through every floor — under a bank-run shock the battery must show the price broken (<= 0.5x), not a dip-and-recover
